turns.speaker: Maya Chen
turns.text: My bloating has gone away and the bleeding finished yesterday.

turns.speaker: Dr Neri Solan
turns.text: The final laboratory report records 12 retrieved oocytes and 10 mature. Eight fertilized normally and four blastocysts were frozen.

turns.speaker: Maya Chen
turns.text: I want a break before transfer.

turns.speaker: Dr Neri Solan
turns.text: We can plan for November and review preparation in October. No embryo has been transferred yet.
